items.briefing:
Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger scam defences, with experts warning that simply telling staff to "stay vigilant" is no longer enough. Businesses are being urged to put real controls in place — such as verified payment processes and multi-step approvals — rather than relying on individuals to spot threats on their own. Separately, poorly configured AI tools are creating new security risks, as misconfigured AI models can expose sensitive organisational data or be manipulated by attackers.

**Practical tip:** Review any AI tools your organisation uses and confirm they have been set up securely — if you're unsure, raise it with your IT team.
